description: This file is a shell script that sets up and tests interactions with a Subversion (SVN) repository, including creation, configuration, starting SVN server processes, and handling prerequisites like Perl SVN libraries and HTTPD support.

methods.name: svn_cmd
methods.description: Wraps the SVN command with a specific configuration directory, ensuring the config directory exists.

methods.name: maybe_start_httpd
methods.description: Optionally starts an HTTP daemon for SVN if environment conditions are met.

methods.name: convert_to_rev_db
methods.description: Converts a raw input file into a revision database format using Perl.

methods.name: require_svnserve
methods.description: Checks if the SVN serve process should be tested based on environment variables.

methods.name: start_svnserve
methods.description: Starts the SVN serve process listening on a specific port and root directory.

methods.name: prepare_utf8_locale
methods.description: Ensures a UTF-8 locale is available for testing, or skips related tests.
